key_idea: The only freedom is where the 7-bag boundaries fall relative to the string, so try all 7 offsets and check every bag-aligned chunk has no repeated piece.
sketch: For each offset 0..6, scan the string resetting a bitmask of seen pieces whenever i mod 7 equals the offset, and fail if a piece repeats within a chunk; partial chunks at both ends only need distinctness. Answer 1 if any offset works. O(7*|s|) per test, total 7e5. Pitfall: partial first and last chunks are fine as long as they contain no duplicates.
